details:
DEMP : Dynamic Electrostatic Mass Transport Protocol

DEMP is an Arduino-controlled Electrodynamic Dust Shield (EDS) designed to actively repel abrasive lunar and Martian regolith from solar panels, sensors, and legacy surface equipment using multi-phase electrostatic traveling waves.

The Problem: Lunar and Martian regolith is sharp, abrasive, and electrostatically charged. During space missions, accumulated dust clings to critical hardware, scratches optical lenses, wears down mechanical joints, and degrades thermal radiators.

Our Solution (DEMP): The Dynamic Electrostatic Mass Transport Protocol (DEMP) uses an Arduino Uno microcontroller and a relay switching module to deliver synchronized electrical pulses across an interdigitated copper electrode grid. By sequencing a multi-phase traveling electrostatic wave, DEMP lifts and sweeps charged dust particles completely off the surface without requiring moving parts, brushes, or mechanical wipers.

Challenge Alignment (Abandoned in Place): By protecting legacy assets and future lunar infrastructure from dust accumulation, DEMP provides a lightweight, automated, and power-efficient method to preserve equipment lifespan during long term space exploration
